Neo series · N4

Neo Destiny

Released February 28, 2002 · 113 cards

Neo Destiny is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Neo series, released in English on February 28, 2002. Its main set has 105 cards, plus 8 secret rares numbered beyond the set (113 in total). It includes 98 Pokémon, 14 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

28 illustrators worked on Neo Destiny. Most cards: CR CG gangs (12), Ken Sugimori (10), Atsuko Nishida (8), Tomokazu Komiya (8), Yuka Morii (7), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Masako Yamashita (6), Miki Tanaka (6).
